jobs.occupation: R&D Group Manager – Compute Platforms & Silicon Prototypes
jobs.description:
Lead the team that turns breakthrough compute architectures into working silicon for the future of AI, high-performance computing and automotive systems.
 

About the role
 

What if you could lead the team that transforms breakthrough chip architectures into real silicon?

At imec, you will manage a multidisciplinary group developing advanced compute platforms and silicon prototypes that explore the future of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing (HPC) and automotive systems. Your work will help define how next-generation chips are designed, integrated and manufactured beyond today's conventional system-on-chip approaches.

You will combine scientific leadership, people management and technology vision in one of the world's leading semiconductor research environments.

 

What you will do
 

As R&D Group Manager, you will lead a team of architects and engineers developing advanced compute systems from concept to silicon validation.

You will:
 
 

• Lead a team of chip architects, silicon designers and R&D engineers. 

• Translate novel computing concepts into manufacturable silicon demonstrators. 

• Drive the development of next-generation compute platforms based on RISC-V and chiplet-based architectures. 

• Guide projects across the complete development cycle, from architectural exploration to prototype fabrication. 

• Enable close collaboration between architecture, software, design technology and silicon implementation experts. 

• Build a high-performing team by coaching, mentoring and developing researchers and engineers. 

• Help shape imec's vision for future 3D-integrated computing systems.  

Who you are
 

You combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership.

You bring:

Must-have
 
 

• 10+ years of experience in digital system architecture and semiconductor design. 

• Solid understanding of advanced chip and compute-system development. 

• Experience with RISC-V or similar processor architectures. 

• Previous experience leading engineers, researchers or technical experts. 

• Strong communication skills and fluency in English.  

Nice-to-have
 
 

• Experience with chiplet-based architectures and die-to-die interconnect technologies. 

• Knowledge of hardware modelling and hardware generation methodologies. 

• Experience with advanced verification methodologies and design automation flows.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

•

You have a responsible, hands-on approach and always work with safety (VCA) in mind

 
• 
You hold a valid driving licence

 
• 
You speak at least one of the following languages: Dutch, French, or English, to communicate with colleagues and understand workplace instructions

What you will do
 

As an R&D Lab Responsible, you will take ownership of the daily operations of one or more research laboratories, ensuring a safe, efficient, and well-organized environment that enables researchers and engineers to perform at their best.
 

You will act as the main operational point of contact for lab users and service partners, driving continuous improvement, ensuring compliance with safety and quality requirements, and coordinating activities that keep the laboratory running smoothly.
 

Laboratory Operations
 
 

• Coordinate daily operations in the assigned laboratories and act as the primary point of contact for lab users and service teams. 

• Define and maintain laboratory standards and ways of working, ensuring compliance with laboratory procedures and agreed practices. 

• Organize onboarding and safety training for new laboratory users. 

• Coordinate laboratory users and supporting staff where applicable, ensuring efficient collaboration and adherence to priorities. 

• Own the accuracy of laboratory data platforms, including user access, inventory, and tool status information, ensuring they remain complete, reliable, and up to date. 

• Drive the availability and readiness of consumables, chemicals, tool calibrations, and maintenance activities, coordinating with responsible colleagues and suppliers to prevent disruptions.  

Safety and Compliance
 
 

• Promote a strong EHS culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety requirements. 

• Organize regular safety inspections and ensure timely follow-up and closure of identified actions. 

• Coordinate risk assessments for new chemicals, equipment, and processes, and implement appropriate mitigation measures in collaboration with EHS specialists. 

• Maintain laboratory procedures and rules in line with EHS guidelines and operational needs. 

• Address unsafe situations and behaviors and escalate significant or recurring risks when required. 

• Ensure laboratories remain audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.  

Process Improvement and Technical Coordination
 
 

• Provide operational support for the introduction of new or modified processes, ensuring compliance with legal, operational, and EHS requirements. 

• Coordinate tool installations, maintenance activities, and planned works with hardware engineers, facilities teams, and external suppliers. 

• Communicate operational impacts and changes proactively to laboratory users and stakeholders. 

• Review laboratory processes, workflows, and recurring incidents to identify risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement. 

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance safety, efficiency, and laboratory performance.  

Communication and Collaboration
 
 

• Facilitate regular interactions with laboratory users to understand needs, align priorities, manage changes, and drive closure of agreed actions. 

• Coordinate activities across researchers, engineers, support teams, safety specialists, and suppliers to ensure smooth laboratory operations. 

• Communicate priorities, operational updates, and laboratory requirements clearly and effectively. 

• Organize and support laboratory visits, audits, and inspections, ensuring all practical and safety requirements are met. 

Who you are
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Sciences, Engineering Technology in electricity/electronics or a related technical field, or equivalent through experience. Some knowledge of computer science concepts, such as data management and networks, is a plus. 

• Experience working in a laboratory, technical operations, manufacturing, facilities, or R&D environment. 

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously. 

• A proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership. 

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling you to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders. 

• Ability to provide guidance, set clear expectations, and drive adherence to agreed procedures and standards. 

• Capable of influencing and aligning stakeholders while applying rules and standards consistently. 

• Comfortable providing onboarding, coaching, and constructive feedback to laboratory users. 

• Strong attention to safety, quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. 

• Fluent in English.

Main missions:

Requirements

jobs.occupation: Startup and Ecosystem Manager – EU Chips Design Platform
jobs.description:
Help Europe’s most ambitious semiconductor startups move from breakthrough ideas to market-ready chips.
Apply About the role 
 

Europe is investing heavily in semiconductor innovation, and the EU Chips Design Platform is at the center of that transformation.

As a Startup and Ecosystem Manager, you'll become a trusted partner for startups, SMEs, research organizations and fabless innovators across Europe. You'll guide them through the platform, connect them with the right expertise and resources, and help accelerate their path from concept to silicon.
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you'll combine ecosystem building, stakeholder management and startup support.

You will:
 
 

• Guide and onboard users of the EU Chips Design Platform throughout their innovation journey. 

• Act as the primary contact for startups, SMEs and research teams using the platform. 

• Manage imec's contribution to the Venture Development Program, including mentoring, incubation and acceleration activities. 

• Support participants in applying for Financial Support to Third Parties (FSTP) funding opportunities. 

• Promote the platform across the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Build strong relationships with startups, investors, competence centers and industry stakeholders throughout Europe. 

• Identify opportunities to improve the user experience and continuously strengthen the platform's services. 

• Help shape a thriving European chip design community.

   

Why this role is unique
 

This is more than an account management role. You'll help build the ecosystem that enables the next generation of European chip companies to succeed. It offers the unique combination of: 
 
 

• Direct impact on Europe's semiconductor future. 

• Daily interaction with ambitious deep-tech startups. 

• Exposure to a broad network of innovators, investors and technology leaders. 

• The opportunity to help build a flagship initiative under the European Chips Act. 

• The reputation, expertise and global reach of imec behind you.  

You'll have the chance to influence how tomorrow's chip companies are created, funded and scaled.

Who you are
 

We're looking for someone who combines technical understanding with a passion for helping innovators succeed, with:
 
 

• A PhD, Master's degree or equivalent experience in microelectronics, electrical engineering, physics or a related field. 

• Knowledge of ASIC design and semiconductor development. 

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 

• A customer-focused mindset and entrepreneurial attitude. 

• Willingness to travel frequently (10 % of your time) mostly in Europe. 

• Excellent English communication skills.  

It’s an asset if you also bring: 
 
 

• Experience working with startups or innovation ecosystems. 

• Familiarity with venture development, incubation or accelerator programs. 

• An existing network within the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Experience with multiple chip design flows or EDA tools.

Job description 

Are you an experienced truck driver with a passion for the open road? We're looking for a professional and motivated CE driver to join our team for international and national transport routes.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of palletized goods to our clients, including well-known companies like Hubo and Gamma. Your duties include loading and unloading the truck independently and ensuring deliveries to around five customers per day.

You’ll spend +/- 3 nights per week in your truck, giving you the freedom and independence that come with this role. Your routes will mainly take you through the Benelux, Northern France, and the Ruhr region. You are also responsible for maintaining the black box records and accurately completing CMR documents.

You will work closely with the planning department and always adhere to traffic rules and safety regulations. With your professional and safety-first mindset, you help ensure satisfied customers and a smooth operation.
